content: {"like":["Praises historically accurate period dramas with detailed costumes and authentic set design.","Appreciates strong, nuanced performances in royal family biopics and Tudor-era series.","Values thoughtful, well‑written scripts that explore complex characters in historical settings.","Enjoys superb production values and droll humor in science‑fiction or speculative series.","Likes visually exquisite, well‑acted adaptations of literary works with period accuracy."],"dislike":["Dislikes cold, dreary, colorless historical dramas lacking visual vibrancy.","Finds pacing too slow and characters shallow in period dramas.","Criticizes historical inaccuracies and brief cameo appearances in biographical series.","Rejects poorly cast actors whose performances feel off‑putting or unconvincing.","Dislikes portrayals that make iconic figures appear low‑key or unflattering."]}
